blocks.markdown: **Bok** works both as "hi" and "bye" with people you know well. For a more formal or time-specific greeting, use **dobro jutro** (morning), **dobar dan** (all-purpose formal greeting, any time of day), or **dobra večer** (evening). **Laku noć** is only said when parting for the night, never as a greeting.
Politeness words: **molim** (please — also doubles as "you're welcome" or "pardon?"), **hvala** (thank you), and **nema na čemu** (you're welcome).
